name: caustic-fold-N0.3
description: Strongly-aberrated plano-convex singlet (convex-first, f~5.2mm, f/3.65, N_F~82) at a through-focus plane 1.0 LSA short of the marginal focus, where the collimated ray map FOLDS into a single caustic ring (multi-valued, 2 branches) with Airy-type fringes. Reference field by dense direct Rayleigh-Sommerfeld ring integral. lambda=1.31um.
